output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is zero, the 'balances[msg.sender] -= _value' statement will cause the balance of the attacker's account to increase uncontrollably.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is large, it can cause an integer underflow in the 'balances[_to] += _value' statement, making the totalSupply of the token unpredictable.
